title: Restrict or show specific ERPNext modules (like Selling, Buying) based on user role using custom app

posts.name: Aniket
posts.cooked:
Hello everyone,
so, i basically create app in my vs code i.e custom_ui ,in that i have created and used directing in public js /css , in js / css code i have given created new ui like min navbar and sliding menu . basically i only to coding part in js and css . now i want to show only specific modules like selling buying to specific user.i have research about it but don’t work out so anyone please give me solution. solution should be in related to coding and also i more condition based specific user role means user is sales manager then selling module only accessible or visible for him

I’ve created a custom app called custom_ui for my ERPNext site (running on localhost).
This app modifies the desk UI using custom JS and CSS (e.g. mini navbar and sliding menu).

Now, I want to restrict specific modules based on user role through code (not via Role Permission Manager).

Example:

  • If user role = Sales Manager → only Selling module visible
  • If user role = Purchase Manager → only Buying module visible
  • Others → hide these modules completely from desk

I’ve already tried a few client-side JS methods, but they didn’t work reliably (modules still show in search or on refresh).

So I want to do this through coding (preferably hooks or boot_session) — something like:

  • hooks.py → boot_session = "custom_ui.restrict_modules.customize_boot_session"
  • Python logic to filter bootinfo.allowed_modules based on role

Has anyone implemented this properly before?
Any example or best practice code would be very helpful
